title: Failure labels / discovery extraction: strip only the bullet marker plus following whitespace, never a character set, so symptoms starting with '-', '*' or '+' survive
answers: Failure label text is missing its leading minus sign, e.g. '-1 returned instead of error' shows up as '1 returned instead of error'
Why does the discovery failure label drop a leading hyphen or asterisk from the symptom?
Where are bullet markers removed from LLM-generated failure labels in the discovery/extraction flow?
How do I change how the LLM response lines are parsed into symptom labels?
body:
Path: mlflow/genai/discovery/extraction.py:_generate_labels takes the LLM's bulleted reply for one analysis (the failure-label generation step of extract_failure_labels) and turns each non-empty line into a '[execution_path] symptom' label.
Rule: Remove list markers with a prefix regex, not str.lstrip("- "). lstrip treats its argument as a character set, so it strips any leading '-' or ' ' and eats the sign of a symptom like '-1' or '-inf'. Use the compiled _BULLET_PREFIX (r"^\s*[-*+]\s+") and require whitespace after the marker, so only a real bullet is removed.
Symptom: A failure label such as '-1 returned instead of error' or '-inf score emitted' appeared with its leading hyphen missing, so users read a wrong value.
Constraints: Applies to parsing of the LLM label reply in extraction.py. It does not change how spans, analyses, or traces are selected. Any other place that uses lstrip with a character set to remove bullets has the same risk and should use a prefix regex instead.
applies: Parsing of LLM-generated failure label lines in mlflow/genai/discovery/extraction.py; the bullet regex, not the rest of the discovery pipeline.
says: Failure symptom labels are missing their leading minus sign on the discovery dashboard.
Negative numerical values in generated error descriptions are losing their negative signs.
The discovery screen displays positive numbers for failure labels that were actually negative.
Why is the minus symbol stripped from failure symptoms in discovery insights?
Preserve leading math symbols like hyphens and pluses in generated issue summaries.
search: In mlflow/genai/discovery/extraction.py:_generate_labels, bullet markers from LLM-generated failure label lines must be stripped using the _BULLET_PREFIX regex (r'^\s*[-*+]\s+') with trailing whitespace rather than str.lstrip('- '). This prevents stripping the leading sign from symptoms starting with '-', '*', or '+' such as negative numbers or scores. This applies strictly to parsing LLM label replies in extraction.py without changing how spans, analyses, or traces are selected.
